note: The machine-readable manual accessibility qualification record, enforced by tools/ci/validate-accessibility-qualification.mjs as a release gate (workflows/release.yml). Scope is desktop: NVDA + Chrome (Windows), NVDA + Firefox (Windows), VoiceOver + Safari (macOS) and one speech-recognition or switch-access pass. The row id is an evidence contract: each required row fixes its platform, browser family and assistive-technology family (or its allowed interaction modes), and the evidence must carry the canonical browser_family / assistive_technology_family / interaction_mode fields that match it; substituting another row's browser or AT evidence is refused. Every required row must be status "pass" with a strict ISO-8601 tested_at inside the validator-owned 90-day window (this field repeats the window for readability and must equal 90), exact browser and assistive-technology versions (placeholders rejected), zoom_percent 200 from the actual release zoom run, keyboard/live_region/focus/content_loss observations all "pass", asset_identity equal to the current canonical client asset digest, a tester_id present in tests/browser/qualification/tester-keys.json, and an Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the evidence object. No physical mobile device appears in this gate. Rows: status manual_pending | pass | fail | blocked; required rows are exactly the four ids below and are release-blocking until they pass.
